luci-app-qeli.description: Grant access to the qeli VPN client config and service

_comment: `luci.setInitAction` and `luci.getInitList` are NOT parameterised by init script in
rpcd's ACL model: granting them here grants start/stop/restart/enable/disable for
EVERY init script on the router — dropbear, firewall, network — not just qeli. So a
LuCI account handed only this ACL can disable the firewall or stop dropbear.
rpcd cannot express 'setInitAction, but only for qeli'. The options are (a) accept
that this ACL is effectively device administration and grant it only to accounts that
already have it, or (b) drop the write half and have the LuCI page ask the operator to
restart the service themselves, or (c) ship a tiny rpcd plugin exposing exactly
`qeli.restart` and grant THAT. (c) is the correct fix and is a package change, not a
Until then this file must not be read as 'least privilege' — it is not, and the note
is here so the next reader does not assume otherwise.
